title: Woman Acts Like An Entitled Brat Over A Minor Traffic Infraction
description:
#bodycam #news #crime 

On January 2nd, 2023. An officer conducted a traffic stop on a woman who was not wearing a seatbelt. When officers approached her to step out of the car, she became very agitated and believed she did not do any wrong. Upon further investigation, it was found that the girl had invalid tags and a warrant from a different county.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.

#police #cops #news
